hints.tr: `scores >= 60` sana `True`/`False` dizisi veriyor; onu köşeli parantezin içine koy: `scores[scores >= 60]`.
hints.en: `scores >= 60` gives you an array of `True`/`False`; put it inside the square brackets: `scores[scores >= 60]`.

hints.tr: İki koşulu `&` ile birleştir ve **her koşulu parantez içine al**: `(scores >= 60) & (scores < 85)`. `and` burada çalışmıyor.
hints.en: Join two conditions with `&` and **put each in parentheses**: `(scores >= 60) & (scores < 85)`. `and` does not work here.

hints.tr: Kaç tane olduğunu `len(passed)` veriyor. Ortalamayı yazdırırken `round(..., 2)` kullan.
hints.en: `len(passed)` gives you how many there are. Use `round(..., 2)` when printing the mean.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import numpy as np

scores = np.array([45, 82, 91, 60, 74, 38, 88])

passed = scores[scores >= 60]
middle = scores[(scores >= 60) & (scores < 85)]

print(passed)
print(len(passed))
print(round(passed.mean(), 2))
print(middle)
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import numpy as np

scores = np.array([45, 82, 91, 60, 74, 38, 88])

passed = scores[scores >= 60]
middle = scores[(scores >= 60) & (scores < 85)]

print(passed)
print(len(passed))
print(round(passed.mean(), 2))
print(middle)
```
